status: post-outcome exploratory sensitivity plan, frozen locally before this sensitivity execution; not public preregistration
known_before_freeze: The M12 original Wine results and duplicate audit were known: 36 candidates, 24 same-order, seven membership changes, five order-only, four order-only without selected or boundary ties from three blocks. This plan does not retroactively preregister that result.
source: Immutable source/PaperM_R2/transfer/winequality-red.csv and winequality-white.csv; bind their existing SHA-256 values through ACQUISITION_RECEIPT.json before analysis.
identity: Exact parsed row-content identity within colour: canonical UTF-8 JSON of {colour: red|white, row: the full DictReader mapping of all original column names to unnormalised source cell strings}; ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(comma,colon). No numeric rounding, label omission or cross-colour merging.
representative: First occurrence in its colour CSV by the original 1-based data-row index; retain that original row identity and row-index block.

arms.purpose: replicate M12 without editing its evidence

arms.units: first occurrence of each exact content identity
arms.partition: original_block of the retained first occurrence
arms.purpose: de-duplicate content while preserving the retained representatives' original partition assignments
keep identical contents together while retaining source multiplicities

arms.units: first occurrence of each exact content identity
arms.purpose: keep identical contents together and remove content multiplicities

preserved_rules: Alcohol groups <10, [10,11), >=11; pH <3.2 versus >=3.2. G01..G06 in alcohol-band then pH-band order. Old proportion quality>=6, new quality>=7. Highest exact rational proportion first, ties ascending group ID. Empty groups omitted; eligible only with at least k+1 nonempty groups. Every block 0..17 and k in [2,3] is reported; ineligible candidates remain in the ledger with the reason.
endpoints: rows and unique identities per arm
all 36 candidate dispositions and any ineligibility
order-only with no equal selected scores or boundary ties under either coding
distinct blocks for strict order-only cases
complete group counts, exact rational scores, rankings, selected IDs, ties and source IDs
number of duplicate groups crossing blocks
A1 outcomes corresponding to the four strict A0 candidates
comparability: A0 to A1 compares nested retained records under the original partition. A2/A3 reassign content to different partitions; their identically numbered blocks are not matched cohorts or persistence tests for an A0 block. Both k values reuse each block. No inferential independence, organisational replication, prevalence estimate, clinical utility or reviewer efficacy is inferred.
selection_policy: Report all four specified arms and every candidate, including zero or adverse strict-case yields. No alternative namespace, content key, cutpoints, block count, representative, outcome selection or source retry after outcomes are computed.
verification: Reconstruct aggregate counts/ranks independently from raw CSVs and the frozen plan, without importing the production sensitivity aggregation/ranking code. Check exact fraction comparisons and all candidate classifications. Compare A0 against the retained original candidate ledger and public groups. Hash raw files before/after; hash plan and scripts in execution receipt.
scientific_scope: Software/data sensitivity analysis only; no new mathematical theorem, proof, human-study outcome or operational decision advice. This analysis tests a particular duplicate/partition vulnerability; favourable sensitivity is not itself a proof of research novelty.
